refuse.different: Pick a different bottle to pour into.
refuse.notInOrder: That bottle is not in order yet.
refuse.notNext: That is not what comes next. {label}

goal.bySize: They go from the smallest piece to the biggest.
goal.pattern: Every bottle ends up the same.
goal.parity: Odd numbers and even numbers go in different bottles.

prompt.group: Sort the odd numbers and the even numbers into different bottles.

hint.kidTip: Look for a bottle you could empty completely.
hint.corked: Bottle {n} is corked. Finish bottle {by} to open it.
hint.oneWay: Bottle {n} only receives. Pour into it once you are sure of the colour.

left.one: One pour left. Work the rest out before you move.
left.other: {count} pours left. Work the rest out before you move.

hint.noneEmpty: Nothing is empty. Find the bottle you can clear first.
hint.free: Bottle {n} is free. Use it for the colour that is in the way.

sorter.title: Bottle Sort
sorter.noPoursMessage: That path ran out. The rack is back as it was dealt.
sorter.outOfMessage: You are out of pours. The rack is back as it was dealt.

predict.title: Which rack comes next?
predict.rightMessage: A pour moves the whole run of one colour.
predict.wrongMessage: Look again at how many move, and how much room there is.
predict.tipOne: A pour moves the whole top run, not one layer.
predict.tipTwo: Picture the first pour completely; the second pour starts from that new rack.
predict.roomOne: Count the room in bottle {n}, then move as many as fit.
predict.roomTwo: Build the first result, then follow the second instruction from that rack.
